scripts.build: bun run --cwd frontend build && bun run --cwd backend build
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.check:fix: oxfmt . && oxlint --fix . && bun run --cwd backend format
scripts.generate:api: bun run --cwd tools/openapi-codegen generate && oxfmt frontend/src/api/generated/schema.ts
scripts.lint: bun run format:oxfmt:check && oxlint . && bun run --cwd backend lint
